title: Effects of Vaspin on Pancreatic ? Cell Secretion via PI3K/Akt and NF-?B Signaling Pathways
author: Shiwei Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kjicuke

steps.title: Culture INS-1 cells
steps.instruction: Seed INS‑1 cells in RPMI‑1640 medium supplemented with 12 % fetal bovine serum, 500 U mL⁻¹ penicillin‑streptomycin, 10 mM HEPES, 0.11 g L⁻¹ sodium pyruvate, and 50 µM β‑mercaptoethanol; incubate in humidified 5 % CO₂ at 37 °C.

steps.title: Determine vaspin concentration groups
steps.instruction: Divide cultured INS‑1 cells into five treatment groups: (1) control – culture medium only; (2) PA – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid; (3) PA + vaspin 80 ng mL⁻¹; (4) PA + vaspin 160 ng mL⁻¹; (5) PA + vaspin 320 ng mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Test PI3K/Akt insulin secretion
steps.instruction: Assign cells to three groups to assess PI3K/Akt signaling: (1) PA – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid; (2) PA + vaspin – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid plus 320 ng mL⁻¹ vaspin; (3) PA + vaspin + ly294002 – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid, 320 ng mL⁻¹ vaspin, and 25 µM ly294002 (PI3K inhibitor).

steps.title: Test mTOR/S6K1 proliferation
steps.instruction: Assign cells to five groups to evaluate mTOR/S6K1 signaling: (1) NC – serum‑free medium; (2) PA – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid; (3) PA + vaspin – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid + 320 ng mL⁻¹ vaspin; (4) PA + vaspin + rapamycin – same as (3) plus 25 nmol L⁻¹ rapamycin; (5) PA + rapamycin – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid + 25 nmol L⁻¹ rapamycin (positive control).

steps.title: Test NF-κB insulin secretion
steps.instruction: Assign cells to three groups to assess NF‑κB signaling: (1) PA – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid; (2) PA + vaspin – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid + 320 ng mL⁻¹ vaspin; (3) PA + TPCK – 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ palmitic acid + 20 µM TPCK (NF‑κB inhibitor, positive control).

steps.title: Lyse cells and extract protein
steps.instruction: Lyse cells on ice for 10 min in RIPA buffer; centrifuge lysates at 14 000 rpm, 4 °C for 15 min; collect supernatant; determine protein concentration with a BCA protein assay kit.

steps.title: Perform western blot analysis
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE, transfer to membrane, and probe for IRS‑2, phospho‑IRS‑2 (Ser731), Akt, phospho‑Akt (Thr308), mTOR, phospho‑mTOR (Ser2448), p70S6K, phospho‑p70S6K (Thr389), and NF‑κB p65 using western blot.

steps.title: Extract RNA and run RT‑qPCR
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from INS‑1 cells with Trizol (Total RNA Extractor kit); synthesize cDNA and quantify IRS‑2, Akt, and NF‑κB p65 mRNA by real‑time PCR.

steps.title: Measure glucose‑stimulated insulin secretion
steps.instruction: Seed 2.5 × 10⁵ INS‑1 cells per well in 24‑well plates; treat with 16.7 mmol L⁻¹ glucose for 1 h; collect supernatant and determine insulin concentration with an ELISA kit.

steps.title: Assess cell proliferation with CCK‑8
steps.instruction: After treatments, add 10 µL CCK‑8 solution to each well 4 h before the end of incubation; measure absorbance at 450 nm with a plate reader (include blank and negative control).

steps.title: Establish rat diet and vaspin treatment
steps.instruction: Adapt rats for 1 week, then randomly assign 10 rats to a normal‑diet (NC) group and 20 rats to a high‑fat‑diet (HFD) group. NC diet: 57 % carbohydrate, 18 % protein, 25 % fat; HFD: 37 % carbohydrate, 13 % protein, 50 % fat. After 16 weeks, split HFD rats into HF (n=10) and HF + vaspin (n=10) groups. Administer vaspin intraperitoneally at 320 ng mL⁻¹ (3 mL kg⁻¹) once daily for 4 weeks; give NC and HF groups equal‑volume saline. Record body weight weekly; measure fasting blood glucose biweekly from the tail vein using a Freestyle blood glucose meter.

steps.title: Conduct oral glucose tolerance test
steps.instruction: After overnight fasting at the end of intervention, gavage each rat with 1.5 g kg⁻¹ of 50 % glucose solution; measure tail‑vein glucose before dosing (t = 0) and at 30, 60, and 120 min; calculate the area under the glucose curve (AUC).

steps.title: Conduct insulin tolerance test
steps.instruction: After overnight fasting, inject recombinant human insulin intraperitoneally at 1 IU kg⁻¹ (Humulin R); measure tail‑vein glucose at 0, 30, 60, and 120 min.

steps.title: Perform hyperinsulinemic‑euglycemic clamp
steps.instruction: Fast rats overnight, anesthetize with sodium pentobarbital 50 mg kg⁻¹ IP, and catheterize the right jugular vein for 50 % glucose infusion. Collect tail‑vein blood for insulin measurement. Monitor blood glucose at time 0, immediately after the glucose bolus, then at 1, 5, 10, 15 min and every 5 min thereafter, adjusting the infusion rate to keep glucose at 14 ± 0.5 mmol L⁻¹ for five consecutive readings. Collect ~100 µL blood at 0, 1, 5, 10, 15 min and during steady state; centrifuge at 4500 rpm, 15 min, 4 °C; store plasma at –20 °C. Calculate glucose infusion rate (GIR) using GIR = Rate (µL min⁻¹) × glucose concentration (g mL⁻¹) ÷ 1000 ÷ body weight (g). Use plasma insulin to evaluate β‑cell regulation.
